mapper.sql: comment_id, user_id, poem_id, content, created_at AS comment_time, like_count
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, u.username, c.content, c.like_count, c.created_at AS comment_time FROM poem_comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.poem_id = #{poemId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poem_comment (user_id, poem_id, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{poemId}, #{content})
